parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of White Rock

White Rock is its own city, separate from Surrey, set above the sandy beach and shallow water of Semiahmoo Bay. It covers 5.12 square kilometres and has 21,939 residents, and it was established as a city in 1957. White Rock sits on the unceded territory of the Semiahmoo First Nation, who call the white boulder on the beach P’Quals. The waterfront, Five Corners and Uptown each have shops, restaurants and services. Homes range from strata buildings to houses on the hillside, so the view, the slope and the strata papers usually need as much attention as the home itself.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

White Rock sets its own zoning, separate from Surrey, so Surrey zone names and rules do not apply here.
White Rock’s Zoning Bylaw 2024, No. 2506 is the bylaw in force. The City’s consolidated copy is current to June 2026.
The bylaw lists the rezonings since adoption, including several RS-1 lots rezoned to RS-2 to allow two-lot subdivisions.
The bylaw’s single-family zones carry small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) provisions. Ask the City how they apply to a specific lot.
On hillside lots, height limits, slope and views shape what can be built, so read the zone for the exact lot.

Is White Rock part of Surrey?
No. White Rock is its own city, established in 1957, with its own council and zoning bylaw. Its public schools are run by Surrey Schools (SD36).
How long is the White Rock Pier?
is 470 metres long. It was first built in 1914/15 and restored in 1977, and the section damaged in the December 2018 storm reopened in July 2019.
Can I walk my dog on the promenade?
Dogs on leash are allowed on the promenade from October 1 to March 31. Dogs are never allowed on the pier.
Is the White Rock Pier being rebuilt?

The two-thirds of the pier that were not rebuilt after the 2018 storm are near the end of their service life and need full replacement. The project has federal approval in principle for $25,935,000, about 86.5% of the eligible costs.
